reason: Honestly the free first summary is the only part I'd use. I've quit every tracker within a few weeks, and I'm not paying for Pro until I've actually kept logging long enough to have something worth summarizing.
objection: I've done this before. Three taps a day still turns into homework after a couple of weeks, and with my period six weeks late I'm not sure a tracker tells me anything new. I'd rather my doctor just listen to me.
would_change_my_mind: If I'm still logging after a month and the free summary actually changes how my appointment goes, like my doctor finally takes the irregular cycles seriously or orders the right tests, I'd pay the $7.99 for my next appointment.
